target.currentExplanation: In the diagram of a fungus like Aspergillus or Penicillium, the structure labelled I is likely a conidiospore, which is an asexual spore produced in chains. Sporangium is a sac containing spores, hypha is the filament, and zygospore is a sexual spore.
target.replacementExplanation: The labelled structure is the zygospore formed when compatible fungal gametangia fuse. A zygospore is the thick-walled sexual resting spore shown after fusion; with the supplied option order, zygospore is option C.
